title: Polynomial-Time Randomized Membership
statement: The language of paired encodings of two well-formed algebraic circuits on the same number of inputs whose associated integer polynomials are equal belongs to bounded-error probabilistic polynomial time, with the class defined using finite nondeterministic machines driven by uniformly random choice bits and acceptance probability at least $2/3$.
